description: Add something new to a JSON file. In an object: adds the key; if it is already there you get KeyExists (use json_set to change it). In an array: path .../2 inserts before item 2 (later items move up), .../- appends. Prints "ok FILE#/POINTER". Example: {"path": "cfg.json#/tags/-", "value": "new"}.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER in one string, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think/next; FILE alone = the whole document; FILE#/ is the key named "" (RFC 6901). Relative files start at your workspace.

value.description: required: the new value, any JSON (string, number, boolean, null, object, array); stored exactly as given: a string stays a string

parents.description: true = create missing objects along the way (like mkdir -p)
